fields.Participants: Co-op Board Secretary, Regional Sales Manager
fields.Trigger: Regional sales team identifies candidate cooperative or cooperative contact request

workflows.name: Cooperative Partner Account Creation & Initial Contact

Automation Opportunity: - Online partner inquiry form automatically creating CRM records.
Controls: - CTL-785: cooperative compliance check; Sourcing/Head of Trade / Account Management contact validation.
Cross-references: - links to VS-107 (key account), VS-11 (trade sales)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ineligible entity onboarding risk**: Onboarding fake or unregistered cooperatives, exposing firm to credit losses; mitigated by collecting formal contact credentials and profile sheets.

steps.activity: Meet with cooperative board representatives to present B2B wholesale pricing structures.
Collect co-op profiling sheet: membership size, asset size, sector focus.
Create cooperative prospect profile in B2B ERP system.
Initiate onboarding compliance checklist workflow.

workflows.name: Cooperative Board Resolution Collection & KYC Vetting

Controls: - CTL-785: regulatory compliance checks; VP Legal & Compliance signature approval.
Cross-references: - links to VS-88 (document control), VS-100 (legal operations)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unauthorized signature risk**: Credit line opened based on forged resolution or unauthorized officer credentials; mitigated by requiring notarized board resolutions.
System Touchpoints: - Document management system (VS-88), CRM / B2B module.

steps.activity: Collect certified true copy of Cooperative Board Resolution authorizing credit facilities and naming signatories.
Obtain KYC documents (valid IDs, photos, signature cards) of authorized co-op officers.
Review bylaws and article of cooperation to verify borrowing power limits.
Log verified KYC documents in legal document vault.

fields.Participants: CDA Registration Officer, B2B Head of Trade / Account Management

Automation Opportunity: - API integration with government agency databases for real-time compliance checks.
Controls: - CTL-785: LGU/CDA regulatory compliance controls; Compliance Manager sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Suspended cooperative credit risk**: Extending credit to cooperatives whose registrations have been revoked by CDA, invalidating contracts; mitigated by verifying compliance status directly on the CDA portal.

steps.activity: Access CDA online registry to check status of cooperative registration.
Request current Certificate of Compliance (COC) from cooperative officers.
Verify that the cooperative has no pending litigation, cease-and-desist, or dissolution orders.
Upload CDA registration records and COC to ERP customer compliance record.

workflows.name: Cooperative Financial Performance Review & Balance Sheet Analysis

Automation Opportunity: - Automated financial analysis spreadsheet parsing standard BIR XML financial statements.
Controls: - CTL-785: finance risk controls; Credit Manager limit endorsement.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Insolvent partner default risk**: Guaranty credit lines to cash-poor cooperatives, resulting in high bad-debt write-offs; mitigated by checking bank credit references and audited financial ratios.

steps.activity: Collect three years of audited financial statements, tax returns, and current cash flow projections.
Calculate key financial ratios: debt-to-equity, current ratio, operating margin, and member capital size.
Conduct reference checks with primary deposit banks and existing supplier credit departments.
Compile Credit Assessment Report recommending credit limits.

fields.Participants: Co-op Chairman, Partner Bank Representative, VP Legal (VS-100)

workflows.name: Tripartite Credit Agreement Drafting & Legal Sign-off

Controls: - CTL-785: ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Account Onboarding & Credit Limits (PA-185.1). — legal authorization controls; CFO final approval on credit limits > PHP 5M.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal operations), VS-68 (credit risk)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Contract enforceability risk**: Unclear credit terms or member liability clauses lead to legal disputes during payment recovery; mitigated by utilizing standardized legal templates approved by VP Legal.
System Touchpoints: - Contract management portal (VS-100), Legal records system.

steps.activity: Draft tripartite agreement defining terms: credit line size, payment cycles, bank settlement routing, and member liability.
Share draft with co-op board and partner bank credit department for review.
Revise contract terms per feedback; coordinate final legal review.
Execute contract signing and notarize the tripartite agreement.

workflows.name: Cooperative Group Credit Limit Allocation & System Activation

Automation Opportunity: - Automated account activation notifications sent via email and SMS to co-op administrators.
Controls: - CTL-785: month-end control standards; Chief Accountant credit configuration validation.
Pain Points / Risks: - **System limit overrun risk**: Cooperative accounts activated with incorrect credit limits, allowing over-purchasing; mitigated by requiring dual-person verification in ERP for credit limit setups.
System Touchpoints: - ERP General Ledger (VS-17), POS master data system (VS-29), Credit module.

steps.activity: Create cooperative parent customer ledger account in ERP.
Input approved credit limit, billing cycle (typically net-30), and interest/penalty terms.
Generate unique cooperative customer code and assign to regional store registers.
Verify credit limit status in ERP ledger; notify cooperative officers of account activation.

fields.Participants: Surety Company Agent, Co-op Treasurer, Risk Specialist
fields.Trigger: Group credit activation request (W5302) with high-value limit (> PHP 1M)

workflows.name: Cooperative Guarantor Setup and Surety Bond Validation

Automation Opportunity: - Direct connection to Insurance Commission database to check surety issuer status.
Controls: - CTL-785: finance risk controls; Risk Specialist sign-off on surety bonds.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Invalid guarantee risk**: Surety bond is expired, unaccredited, or carries restrictive claim terms during defaults; mitigated by validating bond issuer against IC accredited lists (VS-116).

steps.activity: Request corporate surety bond or bank guarantee from cooperative officers to secure credit line.
Verify surety company accreditation status and financial rating.
Review surety bond terms: coverage limits, expiry date, and claim conditions.
Activate guarantor link in ERP parent account database.

fields.Participants: Cooperative Treasurer, Credit Analyst, Store Manager
fields.Trigger: Cooperative account active for 12 months or nearing renewal date

workflows.name: Annual Cooperative Account Credit Limit Review & Renewal

Automation Opportunity: - Automated review queues triggering email requests for financial documents 60 days before expiry.
Controls: - CTL-785: finance risk controls; Credit Director renewal sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale credit risk**: Deteriorating financial health of cooperative ignored during limit renewals, causing defaults; mitigated by requiring updated audited statements for limit renewals.

steps.activity: Extract past-year purchase and payment performance: transaction volumes, delay days, collection issues.
Request updated audited financial statement and current CDA certificate.
Re-evaluate credit risks; calculate updated credit rating score.
Adjust credit limit in ERP system and sign off on annual renewal agreement.
